title: MOLTEN SALT REACTOR IMPROVEMENTS
docs.abstract: A method of preheating a feed to a molten material reactor comprises heating a hydrocarbon feed in a first heat exchanger using a cooled product gas to produce a heated hydrocarbon feed stream, pyrolyzing at least a portion of the C2+ hydrocarbons in the heated feed stream in a pyrolysis reactor to produce a pyrolyzed hydrocarbon stream, and heating the pyrolyzed hydrocarbon stream in a second heat exchanger using a product gas to produce a pre-heated feed gas. The heated hydrocarbon feed stream comprises methane and one or more C2+ hydrocarbons.

title: METHODS OF PNEUMATIC CARBON REMOVAL
docs.abstract: A pyrolysis process comprises introducing one or more chemical reactants into a reactor containing a liquid maintained at a high temperature, producing chemical products in the liquid based on the high temperature, allowing the solid product to grow in particle size, accumulating the solid product in the liquid, and removing the solid product from the reactor while retaining a substantial portion of the liquid within the reactor. The chemical products comprise a solid chemical product that is mixed with the liquid.

title: PREVENTION OF SOLID DEPOSITION ON INTERNAL STRUCTURES OF REACTORS
docs.abstract: A reactor system for high temperature reactions of reactants includes at least one reactant containing carbon. The reactor includes a reactor, a liquid media disposed within the reactor, and a solid carbon reaction product. The liquid media does not react irreversibly with the reactant to form products, and the liquid media wets at least a portion of a surface within the reactor. The solid carbon reaction product does not contact at least the portion of the surface within the reactor where the liquid media wets the portion of the surface within the reactor.

title: 一种供应链服务管理系统
docs.abstract: 本发明公开了一种供应链服务管理系统。本发明利用区块链技术为底层支撑，整合了采购需求、审批、采购成单、货运、接收、生成融资报告、发送融资需求、融资发放和企业清结算各环节，避免了单端的人工操作，达成信息流资金流一致，优化企业、供应商和资金方流程，加快融资过程，提升服务效率的目的。供应链上中小企业可凭借区块链的凭证向融资机构获得高效率、低成本的供应链金融服务，同时区块链技术保证票据可信可兑，又不产生额外的财务费用，形成基于真实贸易的数据资产价值，便于批量化业务处理和集团统一化管理，且票据可在一定范围内流通，对中小企业的发展有非常积极的作用，此外，还可以保证整个交易流程透明无虚假交易的风险。

title: 一种酒店订单智能结算管理系统
docs.abstract: 本发明公开了一种酒店订单智能结算管理系统。本发明中，从订单预订到支付，完成一个闭环的信息流，保证资金与信息的一致，从而减少差错率，减少了重复劳动和手工操作，提高了相应环节的效率；利用智能科技和区块链技术开创商务旅行整体商旅智能结算功能，帮助酒店前台轻松管理入住退房流程及帮助财务管理人员提高收益管理；本发明可以帮助企业商旅管理人员和财务人员执行大量重复任务，繁琐的后台人工流程，基于规则的业务流程将细微、复杂和经常中断的过程自动化并进行机器学习；同时实现降本增效的功能。帮助企业财务团队发现错误，对于企业管理人士更轻松地管理并优化商旅费用支出，简化商旅结算流程，提升企业合规经营水平。
